name: direct-water-swi-parameters
title: Direct-Water SWI Parameter Tables (cross-provider)
description: Computation-ready parameter tables derived from the JSON extractions under each <company>/json/. Tables are themed by metric family. This is the canonical data dictionary: the combined cross_provider/*_all_providers.csv tables and the per-company <company>/csv/*.csv tables share these field schemas. Every row carries units, the consumption/withdrawal flag, a caveat, and both source_report_id and report_year back-references to the authoritative JSON. The combined and per-company tables are de-duplicated latest-per-key: rows describing the same fact across report editions are collapsed to the most recent report_year, and superseded values are logged in restatements.csv. Derived artifacts only — never hand-edit; regenerate with derive_parameters.py.

resources.name: wue
resources.description: Water Usage Effectiveness (intensity). Use D = workload_IT_kWh x wue_l_per_kwh. Per-company copy: <company>/csv/wue.csv.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Reporting entity; not always specific to a cloud service (e.g. Azure/GCP).

fields.name: service_applicability
fields.description: Scope the value applies to; a fleet/corporate value is not automatically a service/workload value.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic scope; not a physical site unless stated.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Reporting period label (calendar or fiscal year).

fields.name: wue_l_per_kwh
fields.description: Water Usage Effectiveness value.

fields.name: value_qualifier
fields.description: exact, approximate, bound, etc.

fields.name: water_flow
fields.description: Flow of the WUE numerator. Consumption-based impact frameworks (e.g. AWARE) should not be applied to a withdrawal-based WUE without adjustment. Impact weighting is out of scope for this layer.

fields.name: denominator
fields.description: Energy denominator (typically IT-equipment energy).

fields.name: caveat
fields.description: Applicability caveat from the source extraction.

fields.name: source_report_id
fields.description: Back-reference to <company>/json/<source_report_id>.json.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Official primary-source URL.

fields.name: report_year
fields.description: Publication year of the source report edition. Combined tables keep the latest report_year per fact (see derive_parameters.py and README).

resources.name: per_unit_water
resources.description: Water intensities with a NON-energy denominator (e.g. per AI prompt or per response). Distinct from wue (which is per kWh). value_liters is the per-unit water normalized to litres. Per-company copy: <company>/csv/per_unit_water.csv.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value as reported (in reported_unit).

fields.name: reported_unit
fields.description: e.g. mL/prompt.

fields.name: value_liters
fields.description: Per-unit water normalized to litres.

fields.name: denominator
fields.description: The non-energy unit (e.g. prompt, response).

fields.name: report_year
fields.description: Publication year of the source report edition.

resources.name: water_volumes
resources.description: Reported water volumes (withdrawal, consumption, discharge) at total, regional, by-source, and site resolution. value_liters is normalized to litres. Per-company copy: <company>/csv/water_volumes.csv.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Reporting scope (corporate, region, source, datacentre location, etc.).

fields.name: geographic_resolution
fields.description: global, region, site, etc.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Geography name (region, datacentre location, etc.).

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where applicable.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value as reported.

fields.name: reported_unit
fields.description: Unit as reported (e.g. ML).

fields.name: value_liters
fields.description: Value normalized to litres.

fields.name: report_year
fields.description: Publication year of the source report edition.

resources.name: water_shares
resources.description: Percentage-share metrics (e.g. share of withdrawal in water-stressed areas, share from non-potable sources). Per-company copy: <company>/csv/water_shares.csv.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Which share is reported.

fields.name: report_year
fields.description: Publication year of the source report edition.

resources.name: replenishment_and_progress
resources.description: Replenishment, avoided-water, and water-positive progress metrics. These are context/offset metrics; they are NOT withdrawal/consumption/discharge and must not be netted against operational water. Per-company copy: <company>/csv/replenishment_and_progress.csv.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Metric family of the row.

fields.name: value_liters
fields.description: Value normalized to litres where a volume.

fields.name: report_year
fields.description: Publication year of the source report edition.

resources.name: restatements
resources.description: Log of facts reported with a DIFFERENT value across report editions. The themed tables keep the value from the most recent edition; this records the superseded value(s) for transparency. Not a parameter table — do not use for calculation.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Which themed table the fact belongs to (wue, volumes, shares, progress, per_unit).

fields.name: period
fields.description: Reporting period of the fact (same across editions).

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Human-readable identity of the fact (location/region/scope).

fields.name: superseded_value
fields.description: Older reported value, dropped from the themed tables.

fields.name: superseded_report
fields.description: report_id of the older edition.

fields.name: superseded_year
fields.description: Publication year of the older edition.

fields.name: kept_value
fields.description: Value retained in the themed tables (latest edition).

fields.name: kept_report
fields.description: report_id of the retained edition.

fields.name: kept_year
fields.description: Publication year of the retained edition.
